title: North West Personal Motor Industry Outlook - November 2025
content:
## Market pricing

Fictional competitors Meridian Insure, Northgate Cover and Bracken Mutual increased renewal prices by around two to three percent during the quarter.
The observed pattern is consistent with a modest portfolio-wide adjustment rather than a large repricing move.

title: UK Vehicle Repair-Cost Inflation Update - Autumn 2025
content:
